entries.title: Ask in chat sends the question straight away
entries.body: Ask in chat on a Glossary entry, a Citations row, Debate's angle box or Check this claim opens a new chat and asks the question straight away, rather than waiting for you to press Send. Follow-up questions on an explanation do the same. Ask AI in the comment box saves your comment first, then sends it.

entries.title: Quote highlights say what a quote is
entries.body: Point at a purple quote highlight in an article and the card that appears opens by saying what a quote is: a passage the AI picked out as worth keeping, in the article's own words. Where a quote has scores, it also says that stronger purple means a higher score. A link leads to the Quotes section of Help.

entries.title: A change for oversized text on sideways iPhones
entries.body: On an iPhone held sideways, text in the panel beside the article could appear much larger than the article itself. We have told browsers not to enlarge text on their own, which is intended to stop this. We have not rechecked it on a real phone.

entries.title: Very deeply nested quotations no longer crash answers
entries.body: A chat answer containing quotations nested inside one another to an extreme depth could fail while it was being written out. It now displays. We do not know how often this happened in practice.
